outcome: Maternal and neonatal complications during pregnancy
cohort: Pregnant women with SCD admitted to the hospital between 2011 and 2016
finding: Vaso-occlusive pain crises and infections were the most common causes of hospital admission among pregnant women with SCD, with preterm birth being the most common perinatal complication.
mod_finding: C-section was the method of delivery for 44% of the participants.
